Notifications.Select_Notification_004: SELECT "NotificationId", "SequenceNumber", "Operation", "Status", "ProductId", "ProductName", "ProductVersion", "OccurredAtUtc", "ErrorCode", "DeliveryStatus", "DeliveredAtUtc", "ReadAtUtc" FROM public."Notifications" WHERE "UserId" = @UserId AND "SequenceNumber" > @AfterSequence AND "SequenceNumber" <= @Watermark AND "DeliveryStatus" IN ('Pending', 'AwaitingSseAck', 'RetryScheduled', 'Failed') ORDER BY "SequenceNumber" ASC LIMIT @Take;
Notifications.Update_Notification_001: WITH updated AS( UPDATE public."Notifications" SET "DeliveryStatus" = 'DeliveredInApp', "DeliveredAtUtc" = COALESCE("DeliveredAtUtc", CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "NextAttemptAtUtc" = NULL, "AckDeadlineUtc" = NULL, "LockedBy" = NULL, "LockedUntilUtc" = NULL, "Version" = "Version" + 1 WHERE "NotificationId" = @NotificationId AND "UserId" = @UserId AND "DeliveryStatus" IN ('Pending', 'AwaitingSseAck', 'RetryScheduled', 'Failed') RETURNING 1) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM updated) OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM public."Notifications" WHERE "NotificationId" = @NotificationId AND "UserId" = @UserId );
Notifications.Update_Notification_002: WITH updated AS( UPDATE public."Notifications" SET "ReadAtUtc" = COALESCE("ReadAtUtc", CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "DeliveryStatus" = CASE WHEN "DeliveryStatus" IN ('Pending', 'AwaitingSseAck', 'RetryScheduled', 'Failed') THEN 'DeliveredInApp' ELSE "DeliveryStatus" END, "DeliveredAtUtc" = CASE WHEN "DeliveryStatus" IN ('Pending', 'AwaitingSseAck', 'RetryScheduled', 'Failed') THEN COALESCE("DeliveredAtUtc", CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE "DeliveredAtUtc" END, "NextAttemptAtUtc" = CASE WHEN "DeliveryStatus" = 'SendingEmail' THEN "NextAttemptAtUtc" ELSE NULL END, "AckDeadlineUtc" = CASE WHEN "DeliveryStatus" = 'SendingEmail' THEN "AckDeadlineUtc" ELSE NULL END, "LockedBy" = CASE WHEN "DeliveryStatus" = 'SendingEmail' THEN "LockedBy" ELSE NULL END, "LockedUntilUtc" = CASE WHEN "DeliveryStatus" = 'SendingEmail' THEN "LockedUntilUtc" ELSE NULL END, "Version" = CASE WHEN "DeliveryStatus" = 'SendingEmail' THEN "Version" ELSE "Version" + 1 END WHERE "NotificationId" = @NotificationId AND "UserId" = @UserId AND "ReadAtUtc" IS NULL RETURNING 1) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM updated) OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM public."Notifications" WHERE "NotificationId" = @NotificationId AND "UserId" = @UserId);
Notifications.Update_Notification_003: UPDATE public."Notifications" SET "ReadAtUtc" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "DeliveryStatus" = CASE WHEN "DeliveryStatus" IN ('Pending', 'AwaitingSseAck', 'RetryScheduled', 'Failed') THEN 'DeliveredInApp' ELSE "DeliveryStatus" END, "DeliveredAtUtc" = CASE WHEN "DeliveryStatus" IN ('Pending', 'AwaitingSseAck', 'RetryScheduled', 'Failed') THEN COALESCE("DeliveredAtUtc", CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE "DeliveredAtUtc" END, "NextAttemptAtUtc" = CASE WHEN "DeliveryStatus" = 'SendingEmail' THEN "NextAttemptAtUtc" ELSE NULL END, "AckDeadlineUtc" = CASE WHEN "DeliveryStatus" = 'SendingEmail' THEN "AckDeadlineUtc" ELSE NULL END, "LockedBy" = CASE WHEN "DeliveryStatus" = 'SendingEmail' THEN "LockedBy" ELSE NULL END, "LockedUntilUtc" = CASE WHEN "DeliveryStatus" = 'SendingEmail' THEN "LockedUntilUtc" ELSE NULL END, "Version" = CASE WHEN "DeliveryStatus" = 'SendingEmail' THEN "Version" ELSE "Version" + 1 END WHERE "UserId" = @UserId AND "SequenceNumber" <= @UpToSequence AND "ReadAtUtc" IS NULL;
Notifications.Update_Notification_004: WITH candidates AS( SELECT "NotificationId" FROM public."Notifications" WHERE ("LockedUntilUtc" IS NULL OR "LockedUntilUtc" <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND ( "DeliveryStatus" = 'Pending' OR ("DeliveryStatus" = 'RetryScheduled' AND "NextAttemptAtUtc" <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) OR ("DeliveryStatus" = 'AwaitingSseAck' AND "AckDeadlineUtc" <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) OR "DeliveryStatus" = 'SendingEmail') ORDER BY COALESCE("NextAttemptAtUtc", "AckDeadlineUtc", "CreatedAtUtc"), "SequenceNumber" FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT @BatchSize) UPDATE public."Notifications" AS notification SET "LockedBy" = @WorkerId, "LockedUntilUtc" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + @LeaseDuration, "AttemptCount" = "AttemptCount" + 1, "Version" = "Version" + 1 FROM candidates WHERE notification."NotificationId" = candidates."NotificationId" RETURNING notification.*;
Notifications.Update_Notification_005: UPDATE public."Notifications" SET "DeliveryStatus" = 'AwaitingSseAck', "AckDeadlineUtc" = @AckDeadlineUtc, "NextAttemptAtUtc" = NULL, "LastError" = NULL, "LockedBy" = NULL, "LockedUntilUtc" = NULL, "Version" = "Version" + 1 WHERE "NotificationId" = @NotificationId AND "Version" = @ExpectedVersion AND "LockedBy" = @WorkerId AND "DeliveryStatus" IN ('Pending', 'AwaitingSseAck', 'RetryScheduled');
Notifications.Update_Notification_006: UPDATE public."Notifications" SET "DeliveryStatus" = 'SendingEmail', "NextAttemptAtUtc" = NULL, "AckDeadlineUtc" = NULL, "LastError" = NULL, "Version" = "Version" + 1 WHERE "NotificationId" = @NotificationId AND "Version" = @ExpectedVersion AND "LockedBy" = @WorkerId AND "DeliveryStatus" IN ('Pending', 'AwaitingSseAck', 'RetryScheduled') RETURNING "Version";
Notifications.Update_Notification_007: UPDATE public."Notifications" SET "DeliveryStatus" = 'DeliveredEmail', "DeliveredAtUtc" = COALESCE("DeliveredAtUtc", CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), "EmailProviderMessageId" = @ProviderMessageId, "LastError" = NULL, "LockedBy" = NULL, "LockedUntilUtc" = NULL, "Version" = "Version" + 1 WHERE "NotificationId" = @NotificationId AND "Version" = @ExpectedVersion AND "LockedBy" = @WorkerId AND "DeliveryStatus" = 'SendingEmail';
Notifications.Update_Notification_008: UPDATE public."Notifications" SET "DeliveryStatus" = 'RetryScheduled', "NextAttemptAtUtc" = @NextAttemptAtUtc, "AckDeadlineUtc" = NULL, "LastError" = @ErrorCode, "LockedBy" = NULL, "LockedUntilUtc" = NULL, "Version" = "Version" + 1 WHERE "NotificationId" = @NotificationId AND "Version" = @ExpectedVersion AND "LockedBy" = @WorkerId AND "DeliveryStatus" NOT IN ('DeliveredInApp', 'DeliveredEmail', 'Failed');
Notifications.Update_Notification_009: UPDATE public."Notifications" SET "DeliveryStatus" = 'Failed', "NextAttemptAtUtc" = NULL, "AckDeadlineUtc" = NULL, "LastError" = @ErrorCode, "LockedBy" = NULL, "LockedUntilUtc" = NULL, "Version" = "Version" + 1 WHERE "NotificationId" = @NotificationId AND "Version" = @ExpectedVersion AND "LockedBy" = @WorkerId AND "DeliveryStatus" NOT IN ('DeliveredInApp', 'DeliveredEmail');
Notifications.Delete_Notification_001: DELETE FROM public."Notifications" WHERE "DeliveryStatus" IN ('DeliveredInApp', 'DeliveredEmail') AND "DeliveredAtUtc" < @CutoffUtc;
